eldarica.version:
Eldarica v2.3
(C) Copyright 2012-2026 Hossein Hojjat and Philipp Ruemmer

Usage: eld [options] file

General options:
 -h                Show this information
 -in               Read from standard input (defaults to Horn SMT format)
 -assert           Enable debugging assertions. This implies -verifySolutions
 -verifySolutions  Generate and verify (but do not output) models and proofs
 -log:n            Display progress based on verbosity level n (0 <= n <= 3)
                     1: Statistics only
                     2: Invariants included
                     3: Includes counterexamples
 -statistics       Equivalent to -log:1; displays statistics only
 -log              Equivalent to -log:2; displays progress and invariants
 -t:time           Set timeout (in seconds)
 -cex              Show textual counterexamples
 -scex             Show textual counterexamples in SMT-LIB format
 -dotCEX           Output counterexample in dot format
 -eogCEX           Display counterexample using eog
 -m:func           Use function func as entry point (default: main)

Horn engine:
 -horn             Enable this engine
 -p                Pretty Print Horn clauses
 -sp               Pretty print the Horn clauses in SMT-LIB format
 -sol              Show solution in Prolog format
 -ssol             Show solution in SMT-LIB format
 -logSimplified    Show clauses after preprocessing in Prolog format
 -logSimplifiedSMT Show clauses after preprocessing in SMT-LIB format
 -disj             Use disjunctive interpolation
 -stac             Static acceleration of loops
 -lbe              Disable preprocessor (e.g., clause inlining)
 -arrayQuans:n     Introduce n quantifiers for each array argument
                     (default: off)
 -cloneArrays      Use separate array theories for independent arrays
 -noSlicing        Disable slicing of clauses
 -noIntervals      Disable interval analysis
 -hints:f          Read hints (initial predicates and abstraction templates)
                     from a file
 -postHints:f      Read hints for processed clauses from a file
 -pHints           Print initial predicates and abstraction templates
 -pPredicates:f    Output predicates computed by CEGAR to a file
 -logPreds:<preds> Log only predicates containing the specified substrings,
                     separated by commas. E.g., -logPreds=p1,p2 logs any
                     predicate with 'p1' or 'p2' in its name
 -sym              Use symbolic execution with the default engine (bfs)
 -sym:x            Use symbolic execution where x : {dfs, bfs}
                     {dfs: depth-first forward, bfs: breadth-first forward}
 -symDepth:n       Set a max depth for symbolic execution (underapproximate)
 -abstract:t       Interp. abstraction: off, manual, term, oct,
                     relEqs, relIneqs, relEqs2 (default), relIneqs2
 -abstractTO:t     Timeout (s) for abstraction search (default: 0.5s)
 -abstractPO       Run with and w/o interpolation abstraction in parallel
 -portfolio        Run different standard configurations in parallel
 -splitClauses:n   Aggressiveness when splitting disjunctions in clauses
                     (0 <= n <= 2, default: 1)

 -hin              Expect input in Prolog Horn format
 -hsmt             Expect input in Horn SMT-LIB format
 -ints             Expect input in integer NTS format

method: Original SMT bytes unchanged; solver requests include model production. Identical source contents run once per backend, with explicit per-task mapping. No Lean startup or proof checking.

parallel_execution.timing_note: Wall times include fresh solver startup and overlap with the Lean portfolio; these are not isolated solver-speed measurements.

publication.paths: Local filesystem paths relativized; suite labels use the selected source-directory suites; original family labels retained separately.
